_doc: The new v0.2 faction creatures that Pulp Wars has no sprite for (docs/design/FACTION_*.md section 10): Squire, Friar and Dragonslayer (the Realm), the Late King (the Restless) and the Boomshaman (the Goblin Horde). Layers follow Pulp Wars (LESSONS section 5.2) and the lost-world-hero set: style, camera, light, class, subject. No faction layer (the 2000-character cap); each subject carries the colours of the Pulp Wars sprites it stands beside: Realm crimson and gold-yellow heraldry with light steel (HERALDIC), Restless ivory bone, near-black cloth and one violet accent (BONE), Horde lime skin, sand-buff hide, tin and hazard yellow (LIME). Faces south-east; never mirrored. A smaller unit is generated at a smaller request and padded bottom-centred into its class canvas. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: Squire, a chunky cute young squire boy with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny body: a friendly freckled face with big eyes, messy straw-blond hair under a small round light steel cap, a bright crimson tunic with a gold-yellow cross, cream sleeves, dark slate-grey boots, a short light steel sword in the right hand and a huge crimson kite shield with a gold-yellow cross on the left arm, far too big for him, reaching from his chin to his ankles; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a small eager boy, not a grown soldier.
recipes.negative: visor, beard, horse, bow, brown leather

recipes.subject: Subject: Late King, a chunky cute skeleton king seated on a royal litter carried by two small skeleton bearers, filling the whole width of the image: the king has a huge round pale ivory skull with glowing bright violet eye sockets and a wide-open mouth mid-proclamation, a big tarnished bronze crown, a near-black royal cape with a white ermine collar and thin bright violet trim, one bony arm raised grandly and a cream scroll in the other hand; the litter is a near-black wooden seat on two long poles resting on the bearers' shoulders; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: red cloth, green skin, blood, gore, horse, throne room

recipes.subject: Subject: Boomshaman, a chunky cute goblin storm shaman with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a small body, head and ears filling the whole width: bright lime green skin #86c232 with a lighter #acdc55 face and darker #5a9424 shading, huge pointed ears, a manic grin, frizzled white hair standing on end, a pale sand-buff patched hide robe, a tall crooked tin lightning rod with a hazard yellow #fdd20f spiral and a crackling pale yellow spark held up high in the right hand, small black bombs on the belt, bare lime green feet; simple shapes; clearly a reckless spellcaster.
recipes.negative: purple glow, red cloth, skull, gun

recipes.subject: Subject: Late King, a chunky cute skeleton king seated on a royal litter on the shoulders of two small skeleton bearers, one in front and one behind, filling the whole width of the image: the king has a huge round pale ivory skull with glowing bright violet eye sockets and a wide-open mouth mid-proclamation, a big tarnished bronze crown, a near-black royal cape with a white ermine collar and thin bright violet trim, one bony arm raised grandly holding a cream scroll; the litter is a near-black wooden chair on two long poles; the bearers are pale ivory skeletons; simple shapes.
recipes.negative: wheels, cart, animals, red cloth, green skin, blood, gore, horse
recipes.notes: late-king-a drew a wheeled cart pulled by two black beasts, not a litter: bearers named as ivory skeletons, wheels and animals excluded.

recipes.subject: Subject: Boomshaman, a chunky cute goblin storm shaman with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a small body, head and ears filling the whole width: bright lime green skin #86c232 like a fresh lime, not olive, lighter #acdc55 face, huge pointed ears, a manic grin, frizzled white hair standing on end, a pale sand-buff patched hide robe, a tall crooked light grey tin lightning rod with a hazard yellow #fdd20f zigzag bolt crackling at its tip held up high in the right hand, small black bombs on the belt, bare lime green feet standing on nothing; simple shapes.
recipes.negative: dirt, ground patch, fire, torch, purple glow, red cloth, skull, gun
recipes.notes: boomshaman-a stood on a soil patch, skin olive and the rod read as a torch: lime named against olive, the bolt as a zigzag, dirt and torch excluded.

recipes.subject: Subject: Friar, a chunky cute jolly round friar with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a plump sturdy body: a bald tonsured head with a ring of straw-blond hair, rosy cheeks and a big kind smile, a long plain cream-white wool habit down to the feet with a bright crimson rope belt and a small gold-yellow cross pendant, a long pale yellow birch quarterstaff held upright in the right hand, the left hand raised in blessing with a few small gold-yellow sparkles, dark slate-grey sandals; clearly a healer monk, not a soldier; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: armour, helmet, shield, sword, brown robe, brown leather

recipes.subject: Subject: Dragonslayer, one very large chunky cute champion knight, the biggest and heaviest of the kingdom, filling the whole width of the image: a huge round head in a closed light steel great helm with a gold-yellow crown band and a big crimson plume, massive rounded light steel plate armour with gold-yellow rims, a crimson surcoat with a gold-yellow cross, an enormous light steel greatsword held upright, and a big stuffed green dragon head with cream horns and a lolling tongue strapped on his back as a trophy, peeking over his shoulder; dark slate-grey boots; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: horse, shield, skull, brown leather, blood

recipes.subject: Subject: Orc Warboss, one very large chunky cute orc war chief, the biggest of the horde, filling the whole width of the image: a huge round head with bright lime green skin #86c232 and a lighter #acdc55 face, a big open shouting grin with two cream tusks, a dented light grey steel viking helmet with two big curved cream horns, a huge shaggy pale sand-buff fur mantle over broad bare lime green shoulders, a big iron belt buckle, a hazard yellow #fdd20f loincloth, chunky dark brown boots, one big fist clenched and the other holding up a big brass war horn; simple shapes and very few details.
recipes.negative: boar, wolf, red cloth, skull, gun, axe, olive skin
recipes.notes: Bead border_marches-bzc.29: a giant (tier 6) take after the imported 56x80 Pulp Wars warboss (goblin-orc-warboss), keeping its design: horned steel helmet, fur mantle, war horn, yellow loincloth.
